ModMetaData.name: CE Fix: Milira Float Unit Elevation
ModMetaData.author: Meidocho (local patch)
ModMetaData.description: Raises CE collision and shooting height for Milira Float Unit pawns by the same 0.5-cell offset CE applies to native flying pawns. Adds a configurable auto-target policy to control whether automatic weapon selection may pick float units. Does not alter plants, weapons, damage, or manual targeting.
